note: One entry per engine SHAPE, which is the mini batch: `is_fixed` pads the last piece up to it, so a 500-row request at mini batch 100 and a 100-row request scored whole present the same [100, 690] engine and share one cache. build_seconds is a 20 s trickle against a cold cache, so it carries the TensorRT engine build; cached_seconds is the same trickle against a FRESH server that loaded the cache. The gap is the cost every cell would otherwise have paid inside its warm-up.
